stitch.definition:
n. a link or loop or knot made by an implement in knitting, crocheting, embroidery, or sewing
n. a sharp spasm of pain in the side resulting from running
stitch.translation:
n. 一针, 疼痛, 针法, 碎布条, 针脚
v. 缝, 缝合, 装订

stitched.definition:
v fasten by sewing; do needlework
s fastened with stitches
stitched.translation: v. 缝, 缝补, 缝合( stitch的过去式和过去分词 ); [引申]把某物连在一起

stitcher.definition: n. a garmentmaker who performs the finishing steps

stitchers.definition:
plural of stitcher
n. a garmentmaker who performs the finishing steps

stitchery.definition: n needlework on which you are working with needle and thread

stitches.definition:
n a link or loop or knot made by an implement in knitting, crocheting, embroidery, or sewing
n a sharp spasm of pain in the side resulting from running
v fasten by sewing; do needlework
stitches.translation: n. 缝针；针法；缝线；线步（stitch的复数）

stitching.definition:
n joining or attaching by stitches
v fasten by sewing; do needlework
stitching.translation: [机] 缀缝熔接, 柄, 货; 库存的, 现有的; 买进, 装柄, 储藏

stitchwort.definition: n. low-growing north temperate herb having small white star-shaped flowers; named for its alleged ability to ease sharp pains in the side

stith.definition:
a. Strong; stiff; rigid.
n. An anvil; a stithy.

stithy.definition:
n. An anvil.
n. A smith's shop; a smithy; a smithery; a forge.
v. t. To forge on an anvil.

stitt.translation: [人名] [英格兰人姓氏] 斯蒂特 Studd的变体
